{{Term/Store|Herb||Series, TMC}} is a character in {{TMC}}.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= E |publisher= |page= 271 {{Exp Game|TMC}}}}</ref>

==Biography==
Herb is a rich [[Figurine]] collector who owns the [[Music House]], the largest house in [[Hyrule Town]].<ref>{{Cite|Not only am I a collector of figurines, but I'm also rich! Filthy, stinkin' rich!|Herb|TMC}}</ref><ref name="Complete">{{Cite|!? Whooooooooooooaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!!! You did it! I can't believe you did it! This is...a totally complete set! How incredibly awesome! And you even got the legendary Carlov Medal!!! It shines with a beautiful light... It's every collector's dream! What you've shown me here... It's just... It's just amazing. Here, feel free to go in my house and take whatever you want in thanks... 'Cuz, you know, I'm rich! Hahaha!|Herb|TMC}}</ref> He does not appear until after [[Link]] has seen the spirit of [[Gustaf]] at [[Lake Hylia]]; from that point until the end of the game, he can be found sitting at a table outside [[Mama's Cafe]].

If Link collects 130 [[Figurine]]s, Herb will reward him by letting him inside the Music House,<ref name="Complete" /> which contains a [[Piece of Heart]], three [[Chest]]s with 200 [[Rupee]]s in each, and a [[Phonograph]].

He is one of the potential characters to have a random [[Kinstone Fusion]] available.<ref>{{Cite|You want to {{Color TMC|Blue|fuse Kinstones}}? Sure! Let's see how well they fit!|Herb|TMC}}</ref>

==Nomenclature==
Herb is named after the plant of the same name, which is often used to make tea. Herb is also a common shortening for the name Herbert.<ref>{{Cite Web|published= July 2, 2008 |retrieved= January 15, 2023 |url= https://www.behindthename.com/name/herb |archive= https://web.archive.org/web/20220717014116/https://www.behindthename.com/name/herb |title= Meaning, origin and history of the name Herb |site= Behind the Name}}</ref> Herb's Japanese name, {{Romanize|オーレ|Ō Re}}, is the Japanese spelling of "[[wikipedia:Café au lait|au lait]]".
